VHistory - Preset STR History.vi

Owning Palette: Variabe History VIs

Presets history data or appends new data to the current history of a variable that has the String data type. The specified variable must exist and have a history attached; otherwise, the VI returns an error. The VHistory - History Controller.vi is used to configure VarMan to maintain the history of a variable.
See the Variable history topic for more information.

Click the parameters for more information

 

writer IDs specifies the Writer IDs for the respective elements in history. If the history does not maintain Writer IDs, this input is ignored. If the size of this array is less than the size of history and time stamps, its first element is bound to all new history values. If this array is empty, zero (0) is used.
VC Handle specifies the handle of the Variable Context in which the target variable exists. To operate on a global variable, pass -1 to this input or keep it unwired. VC Handle is ignored if name_spec refers to the variable by an alias. See the Referring to variables topic for more information.
name_spec defines the name specifier of the target variable. Usually, this is merely a variable name; however, additional options are available. See the Referring to variables topic for details.
time stamps passes the time stamps (DBL representation), in the universal LabVIEW date/time format, for the respective elements in the history control. The number of elements in the time stamps array must match the number of elements in the history array.
history passes the variable history values. The number of elements in the history array must match the number of elements in the time stamps array.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
append (F) specifies whether the input data appends to the current history or overrides the existing content of the variable history (default).
dup name_spec is a flow-through parameter with the same value as name_spec.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
